subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped `business_connection_id` authority model should it use?
rationale: The feature aligns with major-channel support, but it changes personal-DM access and outbound Business-account authority after a same-repo implementation was closed for security and routing blockers.

options.title: Approve bounded Telegram Business support
options.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require owner design first
options.body: Keep this tracker open and require a short maintainer design note for access control, persistence, and outbound authority before accepting another PR.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Leave users on external relay/proxy approaches until maintainers explicitly approve a plugin/API seam or bundled support direction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Telegram Business support
recommendation.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc closed the prior same-repo implementation with a Telegram-owner-direction note and has recent Telegram seam history.
